title: OVERRIDE: U4 start-daemon.sh resolves Node script from install dir not its own location — breaks adapters/tests
summary: SPEC IS INCOMPLETE: U4's hooks/start-daemon.sh delegation has a real portability bug that the per-unit + integrated judges missed (masked by the pre-existing jq crash on the only test that exercises it, cursor-e2e-integration sessionStart). The new start-daemon.sh does `DIR="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/orchestrator}"; exec node "$DIR/hooks/start-daemon.js"` — resolving the Node script from the INSTALL dir rather than from the script's own location. When run from the repo/worktree (cursor/codex adapters via session-start.sh, and the test suite), CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is unset so it execs ~/.claude/orchestrator/hooks/start-daemon.js which does not exist → hook exits 1 → workspace + session never registered. Fix: resolve DIR from the script itself — `DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0}")" && pwd)"; exec node "$DIR/start-daemon.js"` (start-daemon.js is a sibling in hooks/). Separately, the cursor-e2e-integration sessionStart test fixture uses a BARE temp dir as WS; under the new repo-rooted model repoRoot(bareDir)=null so it correctly does not register — the test fixture must be a real repo (git init / create .graph) to register. Both fixes are part of task /15.
